title: Margaret Munce
clean_html:
Margaret Munce

Preserved Primary Document • munce-m2.htm

Sometime around 1886 she married Enoch Durham , the son of Benjamin Durham and Sally Ann Hansor. Two of her sisters married two of Enoch's brothers. Margaret and Enoch lived their lives in Kent Co., DE and had the following children: Wilbur Durham (Feb. 1897- ) married Mattie Durham Enoch James Durham (June 1890-Dec. 16, 1927) married Cora Carney Elmer Durham (Sept.1891- ) John Durham (1892- ) married #1 Viola Jackson #2 Irene Sammons Wilson Durham (1894-1934) married Ray Beckett Harvey Durham (April 1895-1983) married Birdella Seeney Maybelle Durham (c.1896- c.1928 ) married Elmer Seeney Mamie Durham (1897-1929) married Edward Morgan Jettie Durham ( Nov. 1899- ) I have no information on when Margaret died or where she is buried. Enoch died on 17 March 1921. Margaret pre-deceased him because he married again after her death and started a second family.
